activation_steps: Review exact source refs and the source/mock checks. Do not execute the inactive request.

Consult research/experiment_ledger.md and register the fresh preparation-only H018 job in research/experiment_decisions.json, including job_id H018-observed-baseline-GT-preparation-v1. Freeze a compact exact snapshot containing that H018 entry.

Create a fresh active request from root_request.inactive.json, changing status to active, root_authorizer to root_agent, registered_before_execution to true, registration_ref to the genuine snapshot ref; retain all exact source/config/manifest pins and false native/HS/GPU/replay authorization.
Hash the active request and explicitly admit once through the unchanged credit-v3 guard; preserve the exact returned initial_ledger_pins and all reserve receipts.

Hash the genuine admission and explicitly launch once. Retain stdout, direct_wait_observation.json, launch.json, actual_wait.json and any genuine failed markers. Never infer child wait0 from output files.

Any native stage needs a separate root-reviewed policy and admission. Resolve monomorphic sites/unsupported format handling and fractional-native-age text roundtrip first; never drop frozen sites or round dates silently.
consumer_binding_rules: Direct source/config/runtime/registration/compact metadata refs plus all actual guard view bindings; <=64 refs. Raw VCF/QC and large output JSON are not passed to common.ref.
environment_prerequisite: Source scripts/project_env.sh; existing project runtime only, no install
rollback_policy: Preserve every partial/output/control file and full 50 MB reservation; no deletion, release, credit, automatic retry or replay
